findings.finding: Workflow-level concurrency is still one group per ref, with cancel-in-progress false on main. GitHub retains at most one pending run per group and newer runs replace pending ones. A docs-only push arriving after a runtime push can replace the runtime run; the docs run compares only its event.before..head range, classifies docs, and skips artifact creation. The runtime commit therefore receives neither full verification nor a development artifact. This is the exact requested scenario the change must preserve.
